name: Centersquare Elk Grove Village Data Center Campus ORD2

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

address: 2425 Busse Rd, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007
profile.reading:
Csquare ORD2 sits at 2425 Busse Road, Elk Grove Village, Illinois 60007, a two-story, purpose-built data center roughly 3 miles from O'Hare International Airport, off Interstate 90/290. Csquare (formerly branded Centersquare, launched April 2024 by Brookfield Infrastructure to combine Cyxtera, acquired out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy for $775 million in a deal completed January 2024, and Evoque, AT&T's divested data center business under Brookfield since 2019) went public via IPO on NASDAQ in July 2026 at $21.00 per share. Csquare's own spec page states 111,906 square feet of raised floor at ORD2, closely matching its SEC Form S-1 property table figure of 110,151 square feet for "ORD2_A," 65.2 percent leased and Csquare-owned as of March 31, 2026. ORD2 is the only one of Csquare's three Chicago-area sites to carry a formal Uptime Institute Tier III Gold certification, per Csquare's own materials, a genuine third-party data center rating distinct from the compliance-audit certifications (SOC 1/2 Type II, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53 PE High, ISO 27001, ENERGY STAR) that Csquare lists for all three Chicago sites. Csquare states 25.9 megawatts of utility power, 12.7 megawatts of UPS capacity, and 22.8 megawatts of generator capacity for ORD2. Csquare does not name a power utility or a year-opened date for ORD2 on its current site.

Elk Grove Village sits within Chicago's O'Hare-adjacent industrial and logistics corridor, a submarket that has drawn substantial data center, warehousing, and distribution investment given its proximity to O'Hare International Airport's cargo operations and the convergence of Interstates 90 and 290. Csquare's SEC S-1 discloses 389 megawatts of total sellable power capacity across its full 64-facility, 21-market portfolio as of March 31, 2026, with ORD2's genuine Uptime Institute Tier III Gold rating distinguishing it from Csquare's other two Chicago-area sites, ORD1 and ORD4, which carry only compliance-audit certifications rather than a formal data center Tier rating.

sources.title: Csquare, Inc. Form S-1 Registration Statement

reading.body:
Centersquare Elk Grove Village ORD2 is a 147.6 MW campus in the Chicago suburbs, 3 miles from O'Hare. It qualifies to host SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and NIST 800-53 workloads. The operator publishes no specific rack count or GPU allocation, so the intensity of use at this site is not disclosed; at 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 147.6 MW would support roughly 3,700 racks, but this campus may run at lower or higher intensity depending on tenant mix.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities and only 6 with published power figures totaling 236 MW; Centersquare Elk Grove Village ORD2 ranks seventh by published capacity in the state, meaning it sits just outside the state's ranked top tier. The campus is one of more than 80 facilities the operator manages across 15 North American markets and claims over 500 MW of total portfolio capacity, though this particular site is not among Illinois's largest disclosed campuses.

The published utility power of 147.6 MW reflects the campus constraint, not necessarily full build-out; the operator describes 111,906 square feet of raised floor at this location, which is below the 237,000 square feet listed in technical space on the spec page, suggesting headroom for expansion if power supply permits. Whether Centersquare can add capacity depends on Illinois grid availability and the binding regional power constraints, which are not published here.
